summary: Range Capital Acquisition Corp., a Cayman Islands blank-check company listed on Nasdaq, filed an 8-K reporting a $60,000 drawdown on September 22, 2026 under its unsecured sponsor promissory note, bringing the aggregate outstanding balance to $240,000 of the up-to-$540,000 facility. The note funds up to $60,000 monthly sponsor contributions into the IPO trust account, bears no interest, and matures upon either consummation of an initial business combination or effective winding-up. Repayment outside the trust is only available if no deal closes. Watch for extension votes, deal announcement timing, and trust-account erosion relative to redemption risk.
